title: Argo · Taccuino
shortDescription: Records, transcribes on the phone and photographs documents. No cloud.
fullDescription:
Argo Taccuino is a digital stenographer for people who meet people: trade fairs, customer visits, quick meetings standing at a booth.

It is not a recorder. It only listens while you use it, transcribes on the phone and, with the default setting, deletes the audio as soon as it is transcribed. The conversation does not go to any cloud.

WHAT IT DOES
• Records the meeting and transcribes it while you talk, right on the phone
• Argo local: a transcription model inside the app, downloaded once (about 670 MB), for any phone with Android 12 or later. Where the phone supports it you can also use Google's on-device transcription
• Photographs documents and whiteboards without stopping the recording and reads their text (OCR)
• Only text and photos stay on the phone

AND AFTER THE MEETING
• Share the meeting package with Argo on your computer (optional), or just the text or the photos, using Android sharing to the app you choose

PRIVACY
• No account, no advertising
• Audio, images and text stay on the phone; the Google ML Kit libraries send Google only diagnostic and performance metrics, as explained in the privacy policy
• Meetings, photos and settings are excluded from Google backup

USE IT WITH RESPECT
Before each recording Argo asks you to confirm that you have told the people present, and while it records a notification always stays visible.

Requirements: Android 12 or later, 64-bit ARM processor.
Privacy policy: https://argosnewdreams.blog/argo-privacy/en/
Support: supporto@argo-net.it
